page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top (HISTORIA) with page number 188 at left. Left margin: a marginal note block of four-line side note (catchwords and gloss) beside the first lines of the text. Main text: one column of running text below the head, ending with the catchword-free last line "Græcis" set flush right.

main_text.l: gligendum sed monendum, quod ante An-
tonii Democharis editionem Decreti Gra-
tiani, Collectio hæc Martini Bracharensis,
citata sit, quasi essent capitula Martini Pa-
pæ Romani, qui tamen multis annis poste-
rior est Martino nostro. Hosce errores Gra-
tiani correxit in sua editione Democharesque
& Contius, qui in margine quando Gra-
tianus scribit: Ex concilio Martini Papæ, no-
tant: Martini Bracharensis nomen, ex capi-
tulis Græcarum synodorum. Latissime hac
de re agit Ant. Augustinus noster, Dialogorum
lib. I. Dialog. X. XI. & XII. quorum
primus sic incipit, & hæc quæ potissimum
ad rem præsentem faciunt, habet. Credo
vos non ignorare, si Gratiani librum ab
Ant. Demochare, vel ab Ant. Contio edi-
tum legistis: in omnibus fere capitibus,
quæ habent hanc inscriptionem: Ex concilio
Martini Papæ: additum esse in margine Mar-
tini Bracarensis nomen, ex capitulis Græca-
rum synodorum. Quod à Democharc
factum est, sumitur ex libris conciliorum, in
quibus post secundum Bracarense conci-
lium, illa capita sunt Martini Episcopi, qui
se ex Orientis conciliis ea sumere dicit, of-
fensus varia interpretatione eorum. Unde
autem singula capita sumantur, non adscrip-
sit, quod sciam? sed ego ea conferens cum
Græcis

marginalia.note: 180. Martini hæc collectio per errorem, pro Martini Papæ canonibus habita.

page.notes: The side note is in the left margin; the first printed line reads "180. Mar-", with the note's hyphenated words continued as printed. Some words in the main text are partly obscured by stains. Line "Democharesque" is read as printed "Demochares" & Contius; the printed text reads "Demochares" with "& Contius" and is partly faint. The word "Democharc" and "Demochare" are uncertain readings in places ("Demochare" is clear at the first occurrence). Text in the margin is partly illegible at the far left edge.
